y-m-45-01.s.s2.o.c: Yakarurama chete kumitsetse ine slope. Mapeya aine mutsetse wakamira anofanira kutariswa zvakasiyana.
y-m-45-01.s.s2.r.c: Kana ukaderedza mhando kunyaya apo slope dziripo, chirevo ichi chakarurama. Uku kutonga kunotaura mhando.
y-m-45-01.s.s2.o.d: Hazvigoni kutongwa. Kusvikira tatsvaga mitsetse yakawanda, hatigoni kuziva kana ichokwadi kana kwete.

y-m-45-05.material: Fungidzira denderedzwa C: x²+y²=25 (pakati paorigin, radius 5) nemutsetse y=x+k. k iy-intercept uye chiyero i1. y-m-45-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Dai yaibata pa k iri pasi pe5, pa k=5 yaifanira kunge yatoramba isingasangani. Asi pa k=5 yakasangana pamapoinzi maviri.
y-m-45-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Inobata pa5. Kuverenga kunofanira kuva kwakashata

Mitsetse inotevera inoshandisa mutengo wemutsetse 1 sezvawakaita. Mhedzisiro yakarurama i y=(x+5)/2 kubva ku x=2y−5.
